parent_objective: design source-generation repair targeting clean history-vs-control labels
blocked_by: M1588 clean surface exists but clean_directed_pair_count is 7 below target 8
supersedes: another broad intervention smoke without clean selector target

public_gates: M1590 must design source generation around clean history-vs-control criteria
M1590 must use dominated/control-only rows as negative diagnostics
M1590 must keep high-speed endpoint absence as a caveat
M1590 must not admit materialization training PPO promotion or private holdout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs source-generation repair after selector clean-surface shortfall
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no simulator rerun, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design relaxes clean history-vs-control criteria
stop if design treats M1588 clean rows as training corpus
stop if design routes directly to materialization, training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout
fallback_plan: admit one bounded implementation if design has source-generation caps and selector-based success metrics
route to branch synthesis if another implementation would overfit fixed public rows
stop if clean-source repair cannot be defined without new simulator fidelity
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1589 admits clean source-generation repair design after selector shortfall

admission_evidence: M1588 evidence-quality failed only on clean count shortfall
allowed_updates: M1590 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: implementation or synthesis decision is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1590 is design-only and must preserve current-frame controls as first-class negatives.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1588 selector over M1585 intervention rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If clean-source repair cannot be defined, route to synthesis or stop instead of weakening standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The clean history-vs-control selector can define a source-generation repair objective that targets more clean rows instead of broader pairability.
success_criteria: design pre-registers clean-positive and dominated-negative source-generation targets
design pre-registers source-diversity and guardrail gates
design decides implementation, synthesis, or stop
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M1588 as history-necessity or level3 self-ID evidence
design ignores control-dominated negatives or high-speed caveat
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes or candidate materialization
decision_rule: M1590 passes if it designs a clean history-vs-control source-generation repair route before any replay, materialization, or training.
